lifecycle.title: Anthropic six-stage reference
lifecycle.alt: Plan, Design, Build, Test, Deploy and Maintain form a loop. Implementation planning is part of Build. This layout uses the article's stage names, not its adoption graph.
lifecycle.caption: Reference stage names, original layout. Module assignments and additional governance/retirement coverage are our synthesis.

delegation.title: Bounded agent delegation
delegation.alt: A coordinator assigns independent research and risk analysis, integrates their results into implementation with continuous checks, then obtains independent candidate review when policy requires it.
delegation.caption: An optional toolkit workflow. Continuous self-checking and independent candidate review serve different purposes; dependent work is sequential.

adaptation.title: A portable core with local configuration
adaptation.alt: Invariant stage contracts combine with organization policy and project facts. Runtime permissions, sandboxing, CI checks and adapters enforce the configured boundaries.
adaptation.caption: Keep the core portable. Configure organization policy and project facts, then enforce boundaries through runtime controls and tool adapters.

product-flow.title: From rough idea to working product
product-flow.alt: Nine steps: Discover, Specify, Plan, Build, Verify, Review, Release, Operate and Improve. Each produces the next step's input. Learning feeds the next intent; failed checks return to Build and verification.
product-flow.caption: An original toolkit usage sequence, not nine new playbook phases or an automatic agent pipeline. Use the relevant skills and review their outputs in your product repository.
